scope.summary: B5 driver UnknownIssuer round-trip complete: the upstream rust-oracledb TCPS fast-fail fix (b929016 'fix(tcps): fail fast on untrusted certificate', paired latency-guard c84f482) shipped in oracledb 0.9.1, and oraclemcp repins oracledb / oracledb-protocol to =0.9.1 so the pinned consumer stack no longer burns the retry_count=20 (~20s) budget on an untrusted certificate.
out_of_scope: the local TCPS lane harness script/test (operator-gated live lane; not run in this close)
the upstream driver source (lives in the separate rust-oracledb repo)

entry_points.name: oracledb / oracledb-protocol pin = 0.9.1
entry_points.trace: Cargo.toml pins oracledb = "=0.9.1" (line 53) and oracledb-protocol = "=0.9.1" (line 62). The repin landed in 2a075dff 'deps: repin oracledb 0.9.0 -> 0.9.1' (cites bead u9ldz: 'TCPS fails fast on an untrusted certificate') and provenance was synced in 6b27d31b; 0.9.1 carries upstream b929016. The B5 lane test crates/oraclemcp-core/tests/oci_tcps_e2e.rs::b5_unknown_issuer_with_retry_count_20_fails_inside_fast_budget is the operator-gated live proof for the flip from the call-timeout signature.

limitations: Close condition B in the bead is now satisfied: the upstream fix (rust-oracledb b929016) is published in oracledb 0.9.1 AND oraclemcp is repinned to =0.9.1, closing the differential-first driver-fix round-trip. source.sha is the last commit touching Cargo.toml (6b27d31b); the repin itself landed in ancestor 2a075dff. The B5 local TCPS lane is operator-gated and not executed in this code-free close.
